title: One font weight in signs

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Fix one signage weight so visitors see a stable hierarchy rather than unnecessary stylistic variation.
strategic_value: Medium lettering can give Helsinki wayfinding a consistent voice across locations.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture states the Medium-only rule above a comparison that shows Medium in black and other weights in pale gray.
practical_value: Use Helsinki Grotesk Medium for signs instead of choosing a weight by visual preference.

content_islands.spec: State the exclusive signage weight above the specimen.

content_islands.name: Weight contrast
content_islands.spec: Emphasize Medium while fading Regular, Bold and Black.
